title: Action execution
description: The audit record of one run, carrying frozen copies of the resources that caused it. Published under create, update and delete on the execution exchange.

action.description: The action as it was when this ran, by value.

runner.description: The runner type as it was when this ran, by value.

liveaction.description: The work item this record is the history of, by value. Wire key: liveaction, one word.

rule.description: The rule that fired, by value. Absent when a human asked directly.

trigger.description: The trigger that matched, by value.

trigger-instance.description: The received event, by value. Wire key: trigger_instance.

parameters.description: Input the action was run with.

result.description: Whatever the runner returned. Any JSON type.

result-size.description: Size of the stored result, so a list view need not fetch it. Wire key: result_size.

parent.description: Id of the execution that started this one, for workflow tasks.

children.description: Ids of executions this one started.

web-url.description: Link into the web UI for this record. Wire key: web_url.

log.description: Observed transition history: one entry per status change, appended as it happened.

status.description: The same fourteen values the live action carries; this record mirrors them.
